unit: Eight targeted work packages, NOT counts of libraries or individual missing fields

cases.name: Qt Base / PySide6 / Shiboken / transitivos
cases.material_missing: Exact Windows wheel source/build correspondence, configure flags, compiler/CRT versions, patches, static third-party BOM and notices; QML transitive and software OpenGL provenance.

cases.name: Qt WebEngine / Qt PDF / Chromium / PDFium
cases.material_missing: Exact final 6.140.0 / Chromium 140.0.7339.225 / PDFium source gitlinks, all build patches/GN arguments, enabled codecs/features and generated attribution documents for the actual shipped GN targets.

cases.name: GDAL 3.9.1 declared recipe/source inputs
cases.scope: Nine recipe hashes and official source SHA512 match bundled SPDX; full binary/static BOM remains U04

cases.name: Fiona / GEOS / dependências vendorizadas
cases.material_missing: Complete wheel native/static BOM, exact source/build/patch map for GEOS 3.11.3, libiconv 1.17, SpatiaLite 5.1.0 and FreeXL 2.0.0; selected license alternatives, copyright/notices and SZIP implementation/encoder configuration. Remaining driver/static notices and CRT redistribution provenance. GDAL recipe/source inputs already independently matched; do not resend generic links.

cases.name: Shapely / GEOS
cases.material_missing: Exact GEOS 3.14.1 source, patches, compiler/runtime, CMake flags and delvewheel import-repair recipe for the two renamed GEOS DLLs; all corresponding notices. LGPL-2.1 GEOS is separate from the BSD binding.

cases.name: pyproj / PROJ / dados
cases.material_missing: Exact PROJ 9.8.1 and bundled native source/build mapping and patches; PROJ database/data release attribution and actual included dataset redistribution terms. No extra grids are requested.

cases.name: NumPy / OpenBLAS / LAPACK / GCC runtime
cases.material_missing: Resolve OpenBLAS build identifier 0.3.34.106.0 to exact upstream commit/patches, bundled LAPACK version and build recipe; identify static GCC runtime components and eligible compilation-process evidence for GCC Runtime Library Exception 3.1. The full bundled wheel license is already retained.

cases.name: Microsoft / contrato e distribuição
cases.material_missing: Account-specific current developer agreement and standard/custom app license applicability; Individual account in Brazil with reserved publisher name, restricted capabilities, Store signing/catalog path and technical constraints relevant to LGPL replacement/recombination. No general legal approval is requested.
